scope.excluded: No physical time-generator or energy-scale matching, no dense/continuum Yang-Mills, no spectral gap theorem, and no full unfixed 20-face bulk integral beyond this static three-link checkpoint.
scope.included: Reconstruct and integrate the graph-derived static U-V-W vertical chain with all other links fixed to identity, using exact SU(2) Haar moment arithmetic and a normalized static Boltzmann weight at common kappa.

stop_condition: Stop after C1 evidence and advisor gate. Do not freeze C2 until the accepted C1 result shows which static-integral statement is actually supported. If graph reduction, independent moment agreement, rigorous normalization, or static/physical-scope wording fails, return limited or rejected with the exact failed premise.

character_fusion_route.moment_formula: For nonnegative exponents (a,b,c,d,e) on (x,y,z,w,t), compute 2^-(a+b+c+d+e) * sum_{i,k,m} mult(a,i) mult(d,i) mult(c,k) mult(e,k) mult(b,m) N(i,k,m)/((i+1)(k+1)). Here mult(p,n) is the multiplicity of SU(2) character index n in chi_1^p, and N(i,k,m) is the parity-and-triangle fusion multiplicity for the common V character product.
must_verify: exact unweighted Haar common-V discriminator E[x*z*w*t]=1/64
no division by vanishing sine factors
same exact moments and normalized intervals as the character route
conditional_angular_or_polynomial_route.requirement: Use a genuinely distinct implementation, for example conditioning on the common V and integrating U and W with angular polynomial moments, or an independent coordinate polynomial integration. It must not import the producer moment table.

conditional_weight_checkpoint.K_kappa_y: After integrating W at fixed V, K_kappa(y)=sum_m [kappa^2*(1+y)/2]^m/[m!*(m+1)!], smooth at y=-1 and kappa=0 with K=1.
conditional_weight_checkpoint.outer_weight: The outer V integral must use e^(kappa*y) * K_kappa(y) * Z_U(V). Averaging normalized inner expectations against bare Haar, or dropping the Z_U(V) factor, is a different calculation and must fail when claimed as primary.
